{{Vanilla|Ruined Portal}}
A '''ruined portal''' generates as in vanilla. [[Matcha Flavoured]] changes its chest loot: gold is given as raw gold, and gold blocks, ingots, tools and the bell are removed, so that gold is not easily available before iron.
